title: High Influence Small Sets in Boolean Functions
resolution: Kahn–Kalai (2013), Theorem 1.1; published in Bourgain–Kahn–Kalai (2024), Theorem 1.1.

exact_dependency.one_sided_reachability_bound: Jplus <= 1-n^(-C), fixed C>0, all sufficiently large n

bridge: U=Jplus+Jminus-1<=Jplus; n^(-C)>c^n eventually for each fixed c in (0,1).
strongest_verified_result: The requested universal exponential-error guarantee is false, already for exactly balanced functions.
remaining_mathematical_gap: None in the reduction to the cited published theorem; no independent reproof of the entire published theorem is claimed.
validation: All 1,050,698 function–coalition pairs in dimensions 0 through 4 passed finite exact controls.
